list.name: wall
list.request: Write `types/wall.py`: `build(b, part, seed, **params)` builds a town wall along the edge you are given -- three high plus a walkway with a parapet on top of it, steps down to the ground every 24 cells, and joined at the corners so a person can walk the whole length without stopping. **Everything you build has to be reachable on foot from the ground outside it**: a door that opens onto the walkway is a door somebody has to be able to get to, and a turret nobody can walk into is a room in the middle of a wall. Declare `KIND = "edge"`, `NEEDS`, and `PARAMS` for two things of your own choosing that a plan might reasonably want to vary. Different seeds have to give a different wall. Run `check.py` until every instance is clean.
